answer: Standing lapses unless 6 peers re-attest it every 3 epochs, so holding a position requires ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Re-attestations are stored in raven and forge lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the cedar graph. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 617 impostors cost 1193 times the honest price and take 30 times as long to clear. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
